newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast prods little changed amid subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast prods little changed amid subdued trade.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast refined products were flat Friday amid relatively flat futures markets and light participation, dealers said.
Crude oil for July delivery continued its modest late-week rally on Friday, rising 14 cents a barrel to $18.83.
Refined product futures were also little changed today, with heating oil up 0.02 cents a gallon, and unleaded gasoline up 0.32 cents a gallon.
Trade was expected to be thin Monday while traders attend a golf tournament.
June supplies of Los Angeles cleaner-burning CARB gasoline were bid and offered 1.00 cent a gallon lower at 53/54 cents, while conventional gasoline off 1.50 at 51.50/52.50 cents.
CARB diesel in Los Angeles rise slightly to 57.50/58.50, with a deal done at 58 cents, traders said.
Reformulated gasoline in L.A. and San Francisco was offered at a one cent discount to L.A. CARB gasoline.
